query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('left',r.source_id,'right',r.target_id,'source',r.data->'source') AS "pair!" FROM knowledge_relations r JOIN products p ON p.tenant=r.tenant AND p.id=r.source_id JOIN products q ON q.tenant=r.tenant AND q.id=r.target_id WHERE r.tenant=$1 AND r.kind='PAIRS_WITH' ORDER BY r.source_id,r.target_id LIMIT 48
